authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

description.en: Registration of unorganised sector workers on the E-Shram portal to obtain a Universal Account Number (UAN) and E-Shram card. The card serves as a national database of unorganised workers and provides access to social security benefits including accidental insurance coverage under PMSBY.

verifiedConditions.claim: The applicant must be an unorganised sector worker as defined under the Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008. This includes home-based workers, self-employed workers, wage workers in the unorganised sector such as construction workers, street vendors, domestic workers, agricultural labourers, gig and platform workers, etc.
The applicant must be between 16 and 59 years of age at the time of registration.

The applicant must not be a member of EPFO (Employees' Provident Fund Organisation), ESIC (Employees' State Insurance Corporation), or NPS (National Pension System — government employee category). Workers already covered under these formal social security schemes are not eligible for E-Shram registration.

unverifiedEligibility: Gig workers and platform workers are also eligible for E-Shram registration.
Workers who are members of state-level unorganised workers' welfare boards may still register on E-Shram.

requirements.claim: Aadhaar number is mandatory for E-Shram registration. The Aadhaar is used for identity verification and to prevent duplicate registrations. Aadhaar-based eKYC authentication is performed during registration.

A mobile number linked to Aadhaar is required for OTP-based verification during the registration process. If the mobile number is not linked to Aadhaar, the applicant must visit a CSC (Common Service Centre) for biometric authentication.

A bank account with IFSC code is required for registration. The bank account is used for direct benefit transfer (DBT) of any social security benefits. A bank passbook or cancelled cheque may be needed.

processInformation.claim: Self-registration on E-Shram portal: (1) Visit eshram.gov.in, (2) Click on 'Register on E-Shram', (3) Enter Aadhaar number and captcha, (4) Verify via OTP sent to Aadhaar-linked mobile number, (5) Pre-filled details from Aadhaar are displayed — verify and fill remaining details including occupation, skill, bank account, and nominee information, (6) Submit the form, (7) UAN (Universal Account Number) is generated instantly, (8) E-Shram card is available for download immediately.
doesNotEstablish: Self-registration requires an Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Workers without an Aadhaar-linked mobile can register through CSC centers using biometric verification.
Registration is completely free of charge.

processInformation.appliesTo: Workers registering through Common Service Centres
processInformation.claim: Workers can also register at Common Service Centres (CSCs): (1) Visit the nearest CSC with Aadhaar card and bank passbook, (2) The CSC operator assists with filling the registration form, (3) Biometric authentication (fingerprint/iris) is done for Aadhaar verification, (4) UAN is generated and E-Shram card is printed or provided digitally. CSC registration is also free of charge for the worker.

output.claim: An E-Shram card with a 12-digit Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued. The card contains the worker's personal details, occupation, and UAN. The UAN is portable across the country and serves as a unique identity for the unorganised worker. The card also provides accidental insurance coverage of Rs. 2,00,000 (Rs. 2 lakh) for accidental death and permanent disability and Rs. 1,00,000 for partial disability under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY).

fees.claim: E-Shram registration is completely FREE of charge. No fee is charged for self-registration on the portal or for registration through CSC centres. The accidental insurance benefit under PMSBY is also provided free of cost — the premium is borne by the Government of India.

processingTime.applicability: Instant registration — UAN generated immediately upon successful verification
processingTime.claim: E-Shram registration is instant. The UAN is generated immediately upon successful Aadhaar verification and form submission. The E-Shram card is available for download immediately after registration.

sources.title: E-Shram Portal - National Database of Unorganised Workers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: E-Shram is the national portal for registration of unorganised workers. It provides a Universal Account Number (UAN) and E-Shram card to registered workers, along with accidental insurance coverage under PMSBY. Registration is free and can be done online or through CSC centres.
sources.uncertainty: Benefits linked to E-Shram may be expanded or modified by the government through future schemes.

sources.title: The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008
sources.publisher: Government of India, Ministry of Law and Justice
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008 provides for social security and welfare of unorganised workers. It defines unorganised workers and mandates the creation of a national social security board and state boards for formulating social security schemes.
claimsSupported: Legal framework for social security for unorganised workers.
Mandate for registration of unorganised workers.
sources.uncertainty: The Act provides the framework; specific scheme benefits are determined by government orders and notifications.

limitations: E-Shram registration does not automatically enroll the worker in all government welfare schemes; separate applications may be required.
The accidental insurance benefit under PMSBY is subject to the terms and conditions of the scheme and must be renewed annually (premium borne by government).
Workers who subsequently become members of EPFO, ESIC, or NPS may need to update their E-Shram status.
The E-Shram portal requires Aadhaar for registration; workers without Aadhaar must first obtain one.
Benefits and schemes linked to E-Shram may vary by state as states may add their own schemes.
Gig workers and platform workers are a recent addition; specific benefit provisions are evolving.

review.reviewReason: E-Shram registration eligibility, process, and benefits verified against the E-Shram portal and Unorganised Workers Social Security Act, 2008. Evolving benefits and state variations documented as limitations.
